title: CravaNautics
description: this modpack is a compilation on mods for create aeronautics
body:
Cravanautics is a technology-driven modpack built around the power and creativity of Create: Aeronautics. Take engineering to the skies as you design, build, and pilot your own custom airships using complex mechanical systems.

From automated factories to fully functional flying machines, this pack challenges you to master kinetic engineering, resource management, and creative problem-solving. Explore a rugged world, gather materials, and turn them into advanced contraptions capable of flight, transport, and combat.

Whether you're constructing massive airborne bases or fine-tuning compact flying vehicles, Cravanautics pushes the limits of what’s possible with Create-based technology.

Build it. Power it. Fly it.
